items.title: PayPal (NASDAQ:PYPL) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
items.summary: Digital payments platform PayPal (NASDAQ:PYPL) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4.8% year on year to $8.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.38 per share was 8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: eBay (EBAY) Faces A New Seller Threat As Meta Launches Marketplace App
items.summary: Meta has launched a dedicated Seller app for Facebook Marketplace, aimed at professional sellers. The app focuses on enhanced seller tools and potentially lower fees, directly challenging eBay's core seller base. This development introduces fresh competitive pressure on eBay's marketplace model and its high-margin seller segment. eBay, traded as NasdaqGS:EBAY, now faces a new competitor targeting the same professional sellers that are central to its marketplace model. items.title: Meta Launches Seller App To Boost Facebook Marketplace
items.summary: Meta Platforms is launching a dedicated app for sellers on Facebook Marketplace.  Meta stock was a fraction higher midday Friday while the news appeared to weigh on eBay shares.  The new app will be called Seller, according to an announcement from Meta on Friday morning.
